- Then |P|² = [(1−3t)² + 3(1−t)²]/4 = (4 − 12t + 12t²)/4 = 1 − 3t + 3t².
- The dashed hexagon is regular and concentric with the large one, with a vertex at P. Its circumradius is therefore |P|, and its area is (3√3/2)(1 − 3t + 3t²).
- Because the dot has constant velocity, the time average equals the average over t ∈ [0,1]. The integral is ∫₀¹(1 − 3t + 3t²)dt = 1 − 3/2 + 1 = 1/2.
- So the average area is (3√3/2)(1/2) = 3√3/4.
